sections.title: Advanced Restorative Esthetics
sections.description: This course is designed to introduce third year students to the current concepts and principles that comprise a modern perception of esthetics. Students will learn the diagnostic process, indications, contra-indications and limitations of modern materials along with techniques utilized in esthetic restorations. Students will perform and understand the techniques and procedures necessary for the completion of cases involving basic esthetic modalities utilized effectively in practice such as porcelain veneers, diastema closures, CAD/CAM technology, inlays and onlays.
